newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks open up, then drift lower.
newsitem.headline: French stocks open up, then drift lower.

text.p: French stocks opened slightly higher on Monday, but turned lower as the bourse continued its consolidation.
Brokers said the market was technically well oriented, but was still digesting the market's recent climb to the 2,150 level.
They said the market would probably be calm ahead of the Bank of France's weekly tender. Rate cut expectations are not high despite an easing this morning in call money.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 1.62 points at 2,151.07 at 0845 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was 2.5 points lower at 2,156.50. Volume was 400 million francs.

Shares in insurer Union des Assurances de Paris were down 2.49 percent at 109.60 francs ahead of its results due on Wednesday. Analysts expect a fall in first-half profit to 750-800 million francs from 806 million last year.
